definitions.explanation: A gathering where people study or learn about a topic together, such as a class, seminar, or reading circle.

examples.japanese: {学習会|がくしゅうかい}に{参加|さんか}する。
examples.english: Take part in a study group.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{日曜|にちよう}に{歴史|れきし}の{学習会|がくしゅうかい}を{開|ひら}く。
examples.english: We hold a history study group every Sunday.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{学習会|がくしゅうかい}で{防災|ぼうさい}について{学|まな}んだ。
examples.english: At a community study session, we learned about disaster prevention.

notes:
Formed from {学習|がくしゅう} (study, learning) + {会|かい} (gathering).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学習会|がくしゅうかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a study session
- {学習会|がくしゅうかい}に{参加|さんか}する: to join a study group

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勉強会|べんきょうかい}: study meeting — a near-synonym, very common in workplaces
- {講習会|こうしゅうかい}: training course — more formal, led by an instructor
